remoteClasses.name: MoqSubscriberEndpoint
remoteClasses.doc:
Endpoint that receives a live media stream from a Media over QUIC (MoQ) relay.

MoqSubscriberEndpoint connects to a MoQ relay (e.g. a CDN or a local moq-relay instance), subscribes to the broadcast identified by the broadcast parameter, and injects the decoded audio/video into the Kurento media pipeline so that it can be connected to any other MediaElement.

Under the hood the element uses the moqsrc GStreamer element provided by the moq-gst plugin, followed by a decodebin3 stage for auto-detection and decoding of the incoming CMAF stream.

Usage


  # JavaScript (Kurento Client)
  let subscriber = await pipeline.create('MoqSubscriberEndpoint', {
    url: 'https://cdn.moq.dev',
    broadcast: 'my-broadcast.hang'
  });
  await subscriber.subscribe();
  await subscriber.connect(webRtcEndpoint);

Events fired

  • EndOfStreamEvent: The relay closed the broadcast.
  • Error: A transport or media error occurred.

params.name: url
params.doc: URL of the MoQ relay. Example: https://cdn.moq.dev

params.name: broadcast
params.doc: Name of the broadcast to subscribe to. Example: bbb.hang

properties.name: url
properties.doc: URL of the MoQ relay this endpoint is connected to.

properties.name: broadcast
properties.doc: Name of the broadcast being subscribed to.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.doc: Start receiving the MoQ broadcast and injecting media into the pipeline.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.doc: Stop receiving media from the MoQ relay.
